title: USS Delarov disc rises from sea near Adak

tellings.quote: that, but other people did see it emerge from the water. It's a discshaped object about 200 feet in diameter.

plain: In 1945, near Adak Island in Alaska's Aleutian chain, people aboard the US Navy ship Delarov are said to have watched a disc about 200 feet across rise out of the sea. The UFO historian Richard Dolan tells Michels this second-hand, drawing on accounts he credits to Robert Crawford and James McDonald, and notes that while not everyone saw it, 'other people did see it emerge from the water.' If true, it would put an object coming out of the ocean two years before the flying saucer craze began.
